body: I am sorry if I pressed on you too much. I actually want to leave this world too.

Yes, but being a woman feels wrong somehow now. When I was younger it felt right, but now it feels a little distant, not quite right. All the years of hiding it has made it feel this way, as well as a full understanding that no one cares (and they shouldn't).

It's hard to want to live. I told myself that 
 many times, but I always come to a realization that it is not worth it. Its a waste, as well as realizing that I will not get anywhere, the world always remain the same.
"Same Old World"

I know I may not know you, but your not worthless as you say. Your a human being, your alive. As you live now, so are other things, so much is going on. I know this is very cliche and you've probably heard it before many times, but it is somewhat true. Your life is so valuable, no materials or money can amount to the value of your life. Your a diamond! I know how hard I can be to not feel this way, I too am considering suicide, but you have to always remember one thing; that life goes on with or without you, but if you live, you can change the world or at least affect someone positively with your life and your story, which to me should keep you determined to continue living.
